summary: AP2 is a controls protocol at heart: consent capture, spending caps, merchant and payee scoping, time windows and signed receipts are native. What it lacks is revocation, step-up, agent registration and consume-once replay tracking. The best places for an independent controls layer are the agent signer (before a closed mandate is signed), the Credential Provider (before a token is issued) and the evidence store after the purchase.

native.note: The agent proves possession of the key in cnf; who the agent is belongs to the commerce protocol layer.
No registry or know-your-agent step; under the Trusted Agent Provider model verifiers keep their own list of trusted providers.
A non-agentic Trusted Surface shows the Mandate Content and authenticates the user before signing.
payment.amount_range per payment and payment.budget across recurring uses.
checkout.allowed_merchants, checkout.line_items, payment.allowed_payees, payment.allowed_pisps and payment.allowed_payment_instruments.
Optional iat and exp claims on every mandate type (exp recommended for open mandates), payment.execution_date windows and payment.agent_recurrence frequency.
No mandate revocation in v0.2; only short exp and agent-side mandate management.
v0.2 specifies no step-up; a failed check falls back through unresolved_constraint to a user-approved closed mandate. v0.1 had 3DS2 and OTP challenges.
checkout_hash, transaction_id, sd_hash, cnf and the one-presentation-at-a-time rule; consume-once tracking is left to verifiers.
Signed Payment and Checkout Receipts whose reference is the hash of the closed mandate.
Dispute verification steps are defined; retention, retrieval and adjudication are out of scope.
risk_data from the Trusted Surface; no event or telemetry format.
Credential Providers, networks or processors may reject overlapping mandates or invalidate tokens; card networks keep their own controls.

gaps.title: No revocation
gaps.description: An open mandate is valid until exp; there is no revoke message or status list.

gaps.title: No step-up in v0.2
gaps.description: Only the unresolved_constraint fallback; no challenge messages are defined.

gaps.title: No consume-once rule
gaps.description: Verifiers are not told to record accepted mandates; issue 346 reports the samples never do.

gaps.title: Stateful constraints without an owner
gaps.description: payment.budget and payment.agent_recurrence need presentation history, and nobody is assigned to keep it.

gaps.title: Pre-authorization context unprotected
gaps.description: Mandates cover the final checkout, not the inputs that shaped the agent's choice.

controlPoints.what: Narrow the open mandate: merchants, line items, amount range, budget, short exp.
controlPoints.how: Trusted Surface templates and policy that refuse wide constraints.

controlPoints.what: Decide whether the agent may close an open mandate for this checkout.
controlPoints.how: A deterministic signer that evaluates constraints itself and refuses overlapping presentations.

controlPoints.what: Refuse or scope the payment credential.
controlPoints.how: Credential Provider and network checks, token invalidation, budget tracking.
Store the open, closed and receipt tuple and run the dispute verification steps.

checklist.item: Reject any constraint type you do not recognize.
checklist.why: The spec requires unknown constraints to fail.

checklist.item: Compare checkout_hash with the hash of your latest checkout_jwt before completing.
checklist.why: It is the binding that stops a stale or altered checkout.

checklist.item: Record the hash of every accepted closed mandate and refuse repeats.
Keep the agent signing key out of the model's reach.
checklist.why: Anyone with the key in cnf can close the open mandate.

checklist.item: Set exp to the shortest time the task needs.
checklist.why: No user-side revocation exists; apart from exp, an open mandate stops only when receipts or exhausted budget and recurrence limits end it.

checklist.item: Sign checkouts with ECDSA (ES256) and include entropy.
checklist.why: Resolves both sides of the issue 268 conflict.

checklist.item: Store mandates and receipts for your dispute window.
checklist.why: AP2 leaves retention out of scope.
